verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage documents screening against an Adverse Media database and a case-management flow where analysts review alerts and risks and record risk decisions, in the web app or via API. Nothing in the pack shows adverse-media matches with linked source evidence such as articles or URLs, or adverse-media risk categories. missing for 10: documented linked source evidence (articles/URLs) on adverse-media hits, documented adverse-media risk categorisation/taxonomy, independent or hands-on corroboration of the review experience
